ko.head: 고용 165,000명, 예상 크게 웃돌아
s: 10월 비농업 고용은 165,000명 늘어 예상 65,000명을 웃돌았고, 실업률은 4.1%로 예상보다 낮았어요.
발표 직후 비트코인은 60분 뒤 -0.5%였고, 연준 인상 확률은 72%에서 78%로 올랐어요.
과거 비슷한 고용 발표 뒤 S&P 500은 1주 뒤 중앙값 -1.0%였고, 12번 중 5번만 올랐어요.
ko.next: 다음에는 11월 10일 소비자물가(CPI), 11월 25일 PCE 물가와 GDP가 나와요.

en.head: Jobs report much hotter than forecast, payrolls at 165,000
s: Payrolls rose 165,000 versus a 65,000 forecast and 60,000 previous, a stronger-than-expected reading.
Right after, gold fell 0.7% and next-FOMC hike odds rose to 78% from 72%.
After similar payroll releases, the S&P 500 median one-week move was -1.0%, rising in 5 of 12.
en.next: Watch Nov 10 Consumer prices (CPI), with next-FOMC hike odds at 78% after the release.

items.en: Jobless claims

ko.head: 신규 실업수당 청구 189,000건, 예상보다 낮아
s: 신규 실업수당 청구는 189,000건으로 예상 197,000건과 직전 195,000건을 밑돌았고, 고용이 강한 편이라는 뜻이에요.
발표 직후 나스닥 100 선물은 60분 뒤 -0.4%, 금은 +0.3%였고 FOMC 인상 확률은 80%로 그대로였어요.
과거 비슷한 발표 뒤 S&P 500은 1주 뒤 중앙값 +0.1%로 평소 +0.5%를 밑돌았어요.

en.head: Jobless claims fall below forecast, pointing to a hotter jobs market
s: Initial jobless claims were 189,000, below the 197,000 forecast and down from 195,000 previously, a level that means a stronger jobs market.
At the same time, Nasdaq 100 futures were -0.4% an hour later and next FOMC odds showed the Hike 0.25%p contract unchanged at 80%.
After similar past releases, the S&P 500 rose in 6 of 12 and had a median +0.1% one week later.
en.next: The next big releases are the Nov 6 Jobs report, Nov 10 Consumer prices (CPI), and Nov 25 PCE inflation.
